messages:
anna: Heads-up: rollout PR4988 (kernel picker tweak + batching heuristic) pushed to canaries in ap-northeast-2. Seeing p99 regressions on A10 L4 hosts, CI also flagged it. Anyone on this?

ci-bot: [perf-regression] suite=inference-latency, job=merge-ci, delta_p99=+24.7%, clusters=ap-northeast-2-A10-L4, first_seen=2176549900

deepak: I'm on it. Quick look at profiler from a failing host — KV cache hit-rate dropped hard and kernel selection flipped to v2 for small batches.

mike: Can you paste the profiler snippet?

deepak: Sure — top of profile: 
```
kv_cache: hits=552, misses=448, hit_rate=0.55
batch_dist: 1-4: 68%, 5-16: 22%, 16+: 10%
selected_kernel: kernel_v2 (fast-path tuned for large batches)
cpu_wait: increased on nic_rx
```

jordan: That hit rate is wild — previous baseline was ~0.83. Why is kernel_picker choosing v2 for batch sizes 1-4? That should be v1.

liz: Looks like the change in PR4988 adjusted the threshold while adding an egress batching heuristic. Patch comment: "prefer v2 when kv_miss_ratio < 0.4". But kv_miss_ratio calculation uses an EWMA across all shards; in low-hit scenarios it misreports during bursts.

deepak: Bisect points to commit abcdef12345 in PR4988 — kernel_picker.cpp change around select_kernel(). Patch excerpt: 
```
// old: if (hw==A10 && batch<=4) return kernel_v1;
// new: if (hw==A10 && batch_threshold(batch) && kv_miss_ratio < 0.4) return kernel_v2;
```

mike: Also seeing NIC TX queue spikes on the same hosts from monitoring: nic_tx_q_percent=92% right when p99 climbs. Might be a noisy neighbor + kernel_v2 producing different IO patterns.

ops-bot: Alert: host a10-ln-43 shows egress_q=92%, link=10Gbps, retransmits=0.08% — correlated with high kv-evict churn.

anna: This is a rollout blocker for ap-northeast-2. Recommend immediate revert of PR4988 from canaries and stop further rollouts until we confirm.

deepak: Agreed. Proposed quick fix: pin kernel selector to v1 for small batches on A10 and add a safety check on kv_miss_ratio sampling window. I'll open PR4992 with hotfix.

mike: For rollback we can run: `./deploy rollback --pr 4988 --clusters ap-northeast-2` and pause rollout. Who can run it?

jordan: I'm doing the rollback now. Running command.

jordan: rollback submitted, canaries reverted at 2176550620. Monitoring now.

ci-bot: [deploy] revert PR4988 completed for cluster=ap-northeast-2 canaries at 2176550620.

liz: Post-rollback metrics (5m window): p99 back to baseline (-1.8% vs baseline), kv_hit_rate ~0.81, nic_tx_q drops to 12%. Looks clean so far.

anna: Thanks team. Next steps: deepak to push PR4992 (hotfix) + test that kernel_picker respects per-host EWMA windows; mike to add a perf unit test that simulates low-kv-hit bursts; add a canary smoke test for nic_tx_queue behavior.

deepak: Will send PR4992 in ~30m. Follow-up: add region-specific integration in CI to catch A10/L4 differences (we missed that in merge-ci).

mike: Also file incident note and tag rollout-blocker. I'll add a postmortem stub. :thumbsup:

anna: Great. Closing this thread when PR4992 is merged and a 2-hour canary pass completes in ap-northeast-2 and eu-w1.
